claims: Narcos is a Netflix crime drama.
Narcos aired from 2015 to 2017.
Narcos has 3 seasons.
Narcos consists of 30 episodes.
Narcos has 10 episodes per season.
Wagner Moura plays Pablo Escobar in Narcos.
Boyd Holbrook plays Steve Murphy in Narcos.
Pedro Pascal plays Javier Peña in Narcos.
Narcos features DEA agents Steve Murphy and Javier Peña.
Narcos is based on true stories of late-'80s drug cartels and the law enforcement efforts to stop them.
Mexico is a companion series to Narcos.
Mexico focuses on the Guadalajara Cartel.
"Narco" is slang derived from "narcotics".
"Narco" refers to drug traffickers (narcotraficante).
"Narco" refers to law enforcement agents specializing in narcotics.
"Narco-culture" refers to the lifestyle and subculture associated with drug trafficking.
"Narco" is a 2017 EDM track by Blasterjaxx and Timmy Trumpet.
The song "Narco" by Blasterjaxx and Timmy Trumpet is used as MLB pitcher Edwin Díaz’s entrance song.
"Narco subs" are custom-built submarines used by drug cartels to smuggle cocaine.
Narcos uses a mix of dramatized events and real historical footage.
